summary: Two miners killed and 19 sickened by carbon monoxide at the Revenue Virginius mine near Ouray; sheriff's office, Ouray Fire District, and Ouray County EMS responded to the 911 call and a mine-rescue operation brought the two underground victims to the surface, both confirmed deceased by the coroner; MSHA investigated
notes: run 966 Ouray County SO DocumentCenter chunk: Colorado Emergency Management mirrors of the Ouray County PIO releases (final release names victims Nick Cappanno, 34, Montrose, and Rick Williams, 59, Durango; CO poisoning per coroner preliminary report; 19 transported — correction from the initial 20; Ouray Mountain Rescue, San Juan Mine Rescue, CareFlighs also responded; explosion and mine collapse ruled out by the sheriff); incident Sunday 2013-11-17, weekday-verified
